projects.name: Scheming - HackMIT 2026
projects.description: Built a lie detector for AI models that flags when a model's words contradict its own private reasoning, citing the exact line as evidence, and tested it on AI agents playing Werewolf, matching human judgment on 94% of 300 hand-labeled turns. Pointed the same judge at 1,500 real coding-agent sessions, flagging claims like "all tests pass" that the agent's own logs contradicted in 6% of runs at 92% precision, so teams can catch agents misreporting their work before merging.

projects.name: YouTube Shorts AI Optimizer
projects.description: An AI copilot that critiques draft YouTube Shorts before they are published and flags where viewers will swipe away, growing a personal channel from 1.2K to 38K subscribers with 45M total views, then launched publicly to 100+ users. Includes a multimodal eval scoring Gemini's video and audio analysis against retention on 85 held-out Shorts, reaching 0.45 Spearman correlation versus 0.25 for a veteran creator and pinpointing drop-off within 1.5s on 65% of them. Also ships as a remote MCP server so creators can get a publish plan without leaving Claude, running a tool-calling agent on Cloud Run that cut p95 latency from 95s to 18s with parallel tool calls and blocked 98.5% of 200 prompt-injection attacks.

projects.name: GitIntent
projects.description: Built a shared memory layer for AI coding agents that records every change with its prompt, then recalls failed attempts before any agent repeats them, lifting performance 8.3% over the same agent without memory across 36 DeepSWE runs. Designed the hybrid retrieval engine on Redis Stack, fusing HNSW vector search over voyage-code-3 embeddings with BM25 keyword ranking through Reciprocal Rank Fusion and deduplicating matches by snapshot, reaching ~93% recall@5.

projects.name: Inventory & Sales Automation Platform
projects.description: Custom infrastructure for a personal cross-platform retail business on Grailed, Depop, and eBay, logging 60+ international orders and $6K+ in transactions, with automated Gmail order logging and a Playwright service that reposts listings weekly on a 30-day bump-then-reduce price cycle
